details: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller indicated he might support holding benchmark interest rates steady if upcoming inflation data continues to improve. This statement, made in a Reuters interview, caused a significant drop in the probability of a September rate hike and triggered a bullish reaction across cryptocurrency markets. Bitcoin reclaimed the $80,000 mark, with XRP and Ethereum also seeing notable gains. Over $415 million in crypto short positions were liquidated in the last 24 hours as prices surged in response to the dovish signals.
title: Fed Official Hints at Rate Pause, Sparking Crypto Rally

details: The "no-war, no-peace" status quo between the United States and Iran continues to fuel insecurity in the Gulf region, impacting global energy markets. Recent reports indicate ongoing US military strikes on Iranian targets, with President Trump reportedly threatening further action. This prolonged tension contributes to higher risk premiums for energy transport and fosters broader market caution. Such geopolitical instability can indirectly affect risk assets like cryptocurrencies by influencing global economic stability and inflation expectations, despite some temporary rallies observed on hopes of de-escalation.
title: Gulf Insecurity and US-Iran Tensions Fuel Energy Market Concerns
